name: Saudi Arabia

flag.description: A green field with the Shahada (Islamic declaration of faith) written in large white Arabic script, above a white horizontal sword.
flag.symbolism: Green is associated with Islam, the Shahada declares the faith, and the sword represents justice and strength.

hook: Saudi Arabia is green with white Arabic writing above a long sword; it is the only green flag with a sword under its words.
trivia: Because it carries the Shahada, the flag is traditionally never flown at half-mast.
It is made double-sided so the inscription reads correctly from both sides.
